rows.note: Use this for something physically sticking or clinging to another thing.

example.english: This piece of tape can adhere to the bottom of the cup.
example.traditional: 呢塊膠紙黐住咗個杯底。
example.jyutping: ne1 faai3 gaau1 zi2 ci1 zyu6 zo2 go3 bui1 dai2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for sticking to a belief, principle, or course of action.

example.traditional: 我哋要堅持自己嘅原則。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gin1 ci4 zi6 gei2 ge3 jyun4 zak1

rows.note: Use this when something is in accordance with, consistent with, or agrees with a rule, standard, or requirement.

example.english: This report will adhere to the company’s safety requirements.
example.traditional: 呢份報告符合公司嘅安全要求。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 fu4 hap6 gung1 si1 ge3 on1 cyun4 jiu1 kau4
